cases.name: continuous-chain-verified
cases.description: two continuous update-bearing items and a continuous closing item: the form every earlier document has

cases.name: anchored-chain-verified

cases.name: mixed-chain-verified
cases.description: the same chain with an anchored first item, a continuous second item and an anchored closing item, two links: the same report

cases.name: anchored-final-only-verified
cases.description: one anchored closing item and one link: an anchored item with no update is allowed as the last of its sequence

cases.name: link-absent
cases.description: the anchored item has no link

cases.prefix: certify_link_missing{0}: an anchored item has no link

cases.name: link-start-altered

cases.name: link-end-altered

cases.prefix: certify_link_end{0}: the link does not end at the item's root chain anchor

cases.name: link-step-altered

cases.prefix: certify_link_invalid{0}: the link is not a valid receipt of an anchored item

cases.name: link-of-a-different-item
cases.description: the first anchored item takes the closing item's link, which starts at another root

cases.prefix: certify_link_start{0}: the link does not start at the previous verified root chain anchor

cases.name: link-surplus
cases.description: a link no anchored item takes: the same chain would have two encodings
cases.wording: certify_link_invalid{1}: the link is not a valid receipt of an anchored item
cases.prefix: certify_link_invalid{1}: the link is not a valid receipt of an anchored item

cases.name: link-of-the-second-item-missing
cases.description: the second anchored item has no link of its own: it would take the third's, which starts elsewhere
cases.wording: certify_link_start{1}: the link does not start at the previous verified root chain anchor
cases.prefix: certify_link_start{1}: the link does not start at the previous verified root chain anchor

cases.name: anchored-item-without-update-not-last
cases.description: an anchored item that changes nothing is only allowed as the last of its sequence
cases.edit: none (the world's first item is anchored and carries no update, and is not the last)
cases.wording: certify_item_without_effect{0,110}: an anchored item that is not the last of its sequence applies no update
cases.prefix: certify_item_without_effect{0,110}: an anchored item that is not the last of its sequence applies no update

cases.name: anchored-item-with-only-an-unapplied-update-not-last
cases.description: the canonical form is about effect, not about the updates member: an anchored item padded with an update that changes nothing is refused like one without updates
cases.edit: none (the world's first item is anchored and carries one update, a write to acc://dn.acme/oracle with a valid receipt, which the walk does not apply; it is not the last)
cases.wording: certify_item_without_effect{0,110}: an anchored item that is not the last of its sequence applies no update
cases.prefix: certify_item_without_effect{0,110}: an anchored item that is not the last of its sequence applies no update

cases.name: non-monotone-block
cases.description: anchored items whose Directory minor blocks do not increase
cases.edit: none (the second item's block, 120, does not pass the first's, 130)
cases.wording: certify run 1: anchor for minor block 120 does not advance past 130
cases.prefix: certify run 1: anchor for minor block 120 does not advance past 130

cases.name: duplicated-update
cases.description: an update the walk already applied: refused, so a count of the network's writes is injective
cases.edit: none (the anchored item carries the same globals write twice)
cases.wording: certify_update_replayed{57b7ace2b33e5851a709a3c29b3d3642fb137669e9ecf8a9cfec95ba31278a42}: the update was already applied earlier in the walk
cases.prefix: certify_update_replayed{57b7ace2b33e5851a709a3c29b3d3642fb137669e9ecf8a9cfec95ba31278a42}: the update was already applied earlier in the walk

cases.name: continuous-item-wrongly-rooted-then-anchored
cases.description: a continuous item whose proof starts at another root, then an anchored closing item
cases.wording: certify run 0: root proof does not start at the verified root
cases.prefix: certify run 0: root proof does not start at the verified root

cases.name: anchored-then-continuous-item-wrongly-rooted
cases.description: an anchored item, then a continuous closing item whose proof starts at another root
cases.wording: certify run 1: root proof does not start at the verified root
cases.prefix: certify run 1: root proof does not start at the verified root

cases.name: anchor-of-another-chain-genuinely-signed
cases.description: a genuine anchor of another chain: the signatures are intact and the link is valid in its own chain, but it does not start at the verified root
cases.edit: evidence/certify/0 and links/0 replaced by a record of another chain signed by the genesis set, with that chain's own link
cases.wording: certify_link_start{0}: the link does not start at the previous verified root chain anchor
cases.prefix: certify_link_start{0}: the link does not start at the previous verified root chain anchor

cases.name: anchor-re-rooted-off-the-verified-root
cases.description: the link starts at the verified root and ends at the foreign anchor's root, which the genesis set signed, and the genesis link is the same receipt: the walk accepts it and the transaction's receipt, which ends at the world's own root, is refused
cases.edit: evidence/certify/0, links/0 and genesisLink replaced by a record of another chain signed by the genesis set, linked from the verified root
cases.wording: receipt ends at 4b5bb5147f4ecfcfb3ef2e772d1038990c61697e24620fb97c9224a22b15e2ba, not the root 174a338c9842e470aaa4f0c1ea0db5116aa21a31aed54b666d998cec5ec98495 certified at DN 110
cases.prefix: receipt ends at

cases.name: anchor-of-another-incarnation
cases.description: a cross-incarnation anchor: the link is valid and starts at the verified root, the signers are not in the set in force
cases.edit: evidence/certify/0 and links/0 replaced by a record signed by a validator set the genesis does not hold, linked from the verified root
cases.wording: certify run 0: block 110: signer is not an active directory validator
cases.prefix: certify run 0: block 110: signer is not an active directory validator

cases.name: root-proof-null-is-absent
cases.description: a null rootProof is no rootProof: the item is anchored and takes its link

cases.name: root-proof-empty-object
cases.description: an empty rootProof is a continuous item with an empty proof, not an anchored one
cases.wording: certify run 0: incomplete root proof
cases.prefix: certify run 0: incomplete root proof

cases.name: root-proof-merkle-state-only
cases.description: a rootProof without its receipt is a continuous item with an incomplete proof
cases.wording: certify run 0: incomplete root proof
cases.prefix: certify run 0: incomplete root proof

cases.name: record-with-an-unknown-trailing-field
cases.description: a record carrying a field the decoder does not know (Accumulate keeps it as its epilogue): the verdict is the unmodified document's

cases.name: link-with-an-unknown-trailing-field
cases.description: a link is a receipt, not a record: unlike a record, whose unknown trailing field leaves the verdict unchanged, a receipt carrying one is refused as an invalid link at its ordinal
cases.wording: certify_link_invalid{0}: the link is not a valid receipt of an anchored item
cases.prefix: certify_link_invalid{0}: the link is not a valid receipt of an anchored item

cases.name: link-undecodable-before-an-earlier-items-refusal
cases.description: every link is decoded before any item is judged: link 1 does not decode, and item 0, which comes first, has no quorum; the verdict is the link's, at its ordinal, never item 0's
cases.wording: certify_link_invalid{1}: the link is not a valid receipt of an anchored item
cases.prefix: certify_link_invalid{1}: the link is not a valid receipt of an anchored item

cases.prefix: certify_link_missing{2}: an anchored item has no link
